mostWorthwhile.text: Correcting the transcription and linking it to its source was most worthwhile: the error was concrete, and the final ticket showed why checking it mattered.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the cleared motor to its power lead was straightforward and felt more like routine progress than a meaningful decision.

surprise.text: Moth confidently heard a code-box repair where Sal meant a cold-box repair; the fluent but wrong transcript made the risk of noisy input clear.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; even the straightforward sign-repair steps had a clear physical purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the corrected ticket affects the clinic repair, especially since the story connects technical mistakes to tangible consequences.
